packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once CI is green; majors stay manual for review.
OrderFlowDemo sample: one grouped PR a month, never auto-merged. CI does not build the sample, so a green check proves nothing about it, and it is not part of any released package.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Dashboard frontend toolchain (vite, vue-tsc, plugin-vue, typescript, vue): one grouped PR so the lockfile is regenerated once and the Host build runs once.
.NET test tooling: one grouped PR across every test project.
MassTransit 9 moved from Apache-2.0 to a proprietary licence (massient.com/license). Stay on the open-source 8.x line.
vue-tsc cannot resolve the TypeScript 7 compiler entry point yet, so TS 7 breaks the dashboard build. Hold at 5.x until vue-tsc supports it.
Only the NServiceBus transport tracks upstream. Wolverine and MassTransit carry patches under patches/ that break when upstream moves, and azure-sdk-for-net is reference-only.
Batch NServiceBus submodule bumps to one PR a week; upstream moves several times a week via its own Renovate.
